accounting_identity_policy: one reported quantity per decision-state accounting identity

rows.claim_boundary: queue deadline misses in the designed grid; fail-open progression and fail-closed holding are rule-defined consequences, not separate findings
rows.label: Fail-closed timeout activation per initiated case

rows.claim_boundary: exclusive component of the timeout-activated progression union; not a separate policy effect
rows.label: Fail-open evidence-only progression failure

rows.claim_boundary: sufficient evidence with required timely review authorization missing; exclusive union component
rows.label: Fail-open authorization-only progression failure

rows.claim_boundary: evidence and required timely review authorization both missing; exclusive union component
rows.label: Fail-open joint evidence-and-authorization failure

rows.claim_boundary: request-weighted diagnostic; null when no request exists and not a supported-disposition measure
rows.label: Timely review conditional on a review request

rows.claim_boundary: event count, not effort, subjective burden, welfare, or cost
rows.label: Additional modeled interaction events per initiated case

rows.claim_boundary: event count, not staffing cost, efficiency, or overall policy value
rows.label: Additional modeled agency-work events per initiated case
